svg.title: Curved Red on Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid screen colours. Organic red curve traced by eye from the actual reference, including cropped top/left/bottom contacts. Fine irregularities simplified.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://collection.themodern.org/objects/1784/curved-red-on-blue; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
